dct_description_sm: C-band polarimetric backscatter data over first-year sea ice during the spring summer transition period, collected coincident to data describing the geophysical properties of snow, sea ice, and melt ponds (summer). Data are being used to assess the utility of spaceborne C-band backscatter data for sea ice bio-geophysical property inversion, with landfast first-year sea ice providing a stable environment for in situ studies.
dct_title_s: C-band Polarimetric Scatterometer data of first-year sea ice for Arctic-ICE 2012
